title: Cmd-Shift-Return zooms and unzooms terminal, Home and browser panes in one transition of at most 150 ms, with every pane's content and tab bar shown
why: Lawrence 2026-10-29 on v2.2.7-opt: "animations for cmd shift enter need to be better", "make sure cmd shift enter animation is perfect (all the tabs are perfectly visible)". His clip: an opaque layer wipes in over the zoomed pane, the browser vanishes at once and pops back over the zoom at the start of the unzoom, and the unzoom ends in a second step about 600 ms later.
